'''''Echeveria pulvinata''''', the '''plush plant''', is a species of flowering plant in the genus ''[[Echeveria]]'', native to southwest and central Mexico.<ref name="274004-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:274004-1 |title=''Echeveria pulvinata'' Rose |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=17 February 2021 }}</ref> A succulent, it has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Echeveria pulvinata'' plush plant |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/6240/Echeveria-pulvinata/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=17 February 2021 |quote=Other common names; … rosy hen-and-chicks }}</ref> Its variety ''Echeveria pulvinata'' var. ''leucotricha'', under the synonym ''Echeveria leucotricha'', the chenille plant, has also gained the Award of Garden Merit.<ref>{{cite web |title=''Echeveria leucotricha'' chenille plant |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/103614/echeveria-leucotricha/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=10 May 2021 }}</ref>

==Subtaxa==
The following varieties are currently accepted:<ref name="274004-1" />
*''Echeveria pulvinata'' var. ''frigida'' <small>Kimnach</small>
*''Echeveria pulvinata'' var. ''leucotricha'' <small>(J.A.Purpus) Kimnach</small>
